title: NVBitTraceSummary
description: Per-launch NVBit trace summary emitted alongside every kernel launch when run_suite.py is invoked with --mode trace. The full NVBit dynamic_trace.pb is too large to be the join unit; this summary carries the (slug, shape_point, repeat_index, launch_index, kernel_signature_sha256) key per workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/kernel_signature.spec.md, NVBit-derived per-launch metrics (inst_count), and provenance pinning back to the source trace .pb. For retained pre-S4 evidence only, workloads/simbench_bw/merge_evidence.py may replay this record as the NVBit side of the retired two-run join against a frozen CUPTI sidecar validated by workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/historical/cupti_activity_sidecar.v1.schema.json. Active NVBit production neither emits nor requires a CUPTI sidecar. Other cross-references: workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/kernel_signature.spec.md (the canonical kernel-signature inputs) and tools/nvbit_tracer/ (the NVBit tracer that produces the source .pb).

schema_version.description: NVBit trace summary schema version. v1 is the initial revision.

slug.description: SimBench-BW row slug. In retained historical dual-run evidence, this equals the frozen CUPTI sidecar's slug field; active NVBit production has no CUPTI-sidecar dependency.

shape_point.description: SimBench-BW shape-point identifier. In retained historical dual-run evidence, this equals the frozen CUPTI sidecar's shape_point field; active NVBit production has no CUPTI-sidecar dependency.

repeat_index.description: Zero-based repeat index within the run. In retained historical dual-run evidence, this equals the frozen CUPTI sidecar's repeat_index field.

launch_index.description: Zero-based launch index within the repeat. In retained historical dual-run evidence, this equals the frozen CUPTI sidecar's launch_index field.

kernel_name.description: Demangled kernel symbol name as reported by NVBit. In retained historical dual-run evidence, this equals the frozen CUPTI sidecar's kernel_name field.

kernel_signature_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical kernel-signature inputs defined in workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/kernel_signature.spec.md, computed by the NVBit-side adapter. During replay of retained historical dual-run evidence, this MUST match the frozen CUPTI sidecar's kernel_signature_sha256 field; a disagreement on the same (slug, shape_point, repeat_index, launch_index) 4-tuple produces joined_evidence_signature_mismatch. This replay rule does not require a live CUPTI producer.

inst_count.description: Total instruction count for the launch as reported by NVBit's per-kernel instrumentation. NVBit-derived and independent of CUPTI Activity. Replayers of retained historical dual-run evidence may combine the frozen CUPTI start_ns/end_ns values with inst_count to derive an empirical IPC-like timing feature.

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the kernel runner binary that produced the NVBit run. During replay of retained historical dual-run evidence, this MUST equal the frozen CUPTI sidecar's binary_sha256 field; disagreement on the matched 5-tuple produces joined_evidence_binary_sha256_mismatch. The rule preserves the retired join's bit-identical-binary check without creating a live CUPTI dependency.

nvbit_trace_pb_path.description: Repo-relative path to the source dynamic_trace.pb file produced by the NVBit-instrumented run. Provenance pin so reviewers can locate the binary trace this summary derived from.

nvbit_trace_pb_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source dynamic_trace.pb contents at the time this summary was emitted. Provenance pin so a future tree-state mismatch is detectable.

nvbit_tracer_build_hash.description: Mirror of the preflight manifest's toolchain.nvbit_build_hash for the NVBit run that produced this summary. Provenance pin tying the summary back to the tracer build.
